description: This file serves as a compatibility layer for embedding quantized modules in PyTorch. It imports specific classes related to embedding operations from the `torch.ao.nn.quantized.modules.embedding_ops` module and exposes them via `__all__`. The file is still in transition, as indicated by the comment, and is mainly used to maintain compatibility while migrating code to the new folder structure.

classes.name: Embedding
classes.description: A class representing the quantized embedding layer.

classes.name: EmbeddingBag
classes.description: A class representing the quantized embedding bag layer.

classes.name: EmbeddingPackedParams
classes.description: A class for storing packed embedding parameters.
